session.instructions:
An original adult female voice in her mid-twenties, speaking native standard Japanese. Radiant, glamorous, honey-warm mid register with a relaxed, languid, affectionately coaxing drawl. Lush and silky timbre, unhurried tempo, softly elongated vowels and a breathy, playful sweet-spoiled lilt at the ends of phrases, effortlessly charming and at ease.
Speak immediately in Japanese. Say exactly this line once: "せっかく仕事が終わったのに、残業なんて嫌よ。……今夜、ここには誰もいないわよね？". Do not translate, paraphrase, repeat, or add words. Then remain silent. Delivery direction: Playfully spoiled complaint in the first half, then dropping into a hushed, alluring, conspiratorial after-hours whisper in the quiet operating room. Stop completely silent immediately after the final syllable; no trailing breath, sigh, hum, or background noise. Enunciate every syllable clearly and remain silent immediately after finishing.
